description: Narrow one data pack before get_data. With only pack_id, lists the pack's sources and their coverage. Add source_id to list that source's metrics (name, unit, years, aggregation) and its filterable and sortable fields; search to match metrics across the pack by name, description, or keyword; or metrics for full detail on up to 10 exact ids.

metrics.description: Optional. Up to 10 exact metric ids from this pack. Returns full stored detail for each, including description, coverage by era, value statistics, and every source that holds it.

pack_id.description: Pack identifier from get_catalog. Newly catalog-admitted packs require no MCP schema change.

search.description: Optional. Terms matched against metric ids, names, descriptions, and keywords across this pack's sources; every term must match. Returns up to 25 compact metric lines.

source_id.description: Optional. One source_id from this pack's sources list. Returns every metric in that source with name, unit, years, and aggregation, plus the source's filterable fields, sortable fields, and time field.

name: get_pack
title: Inspect One Data Pack
